case: enum_range result and rebind with a same-named shadow enum in search_path
contract: A custom enum and a different enum with the same type name exist in target and shadow schemas, with the shadow schema first in search_path.
enum_range(NULL::qualified_target_enum) preserves target schema metadata, declaration order, empty and Unicode labels, one-dimensional lower bounds, and SQL NULL-free enum array semantics.
Native pg_typeof, array_to_json, array_send and array_dims provide independent type, value, wire-byte and shape oracles.
Rebinding the returned enum array through its typed text cast reproduces native JSON and array_send bytes; a shadow-only label is rejected with SQLSTATE 22P02.
